title: SpecRunnerCosts
description: Output of `spec-runner costs --json` (spec_runner.cli_info.cmd_costs). The per-task read surface that backs the spec-runner-vscode extension's TASKS tree. NOTE: `status` carries a MIXED vocabulary — DB states (pending/running/success/failed/skipped) for tasks that have run, tasks.md states (todo/in_progress/done/blocked) otherwise. Consumers must normalize both. See docs/state-schema.md.

pr_reviews.description: Per-PR totals from the `review-pr` ledger (`pr_agent_calls`). A separate ledger from the task one: these calls belong to a PR comment, not to a task, and are never folded into `tasks[].cost`. Added 2.31.0; absent when the loop has never run in this state file.

calls.description: Paid calls this loop made for the PR (verification and fix), counting failed and timed-out ones whose process started

cost.description: Sum of the priced calls in USD. A floor when `unmeasured_calls` > 0.

unmeasured_calls.description: Calls whose cost the CLI never reported. When > 0, `cost` is a floor, not a total.

status.description: Mixed vocabulary: DB status (has state) OR tasks.md status (no state). The union of both is pinned here; normalize on the consumer side.

cost.description: Cost in USD for this task (0.0 when no state)

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens for this task

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens for this task

unmeasured_calls.description: Agent calls recorded for this task whose cost the CLI never reported (timeout, account limit, or a CLI that reports no cost). Added 2.29.0. When > 0, `cost` is a floor, not a total. Absent in output from <2.29.0.

total_input_tokens.description: Total input tokens across all tasks

total_output_tokens.description: Total output tokens across all tasks

avg_cost_per_completed.description: Average cost across tasks with cost > 0 (rounded to 2dp)

most_expensive_task.description: task_id of the costliest task, or null when none has cost > 0

budget_usd.description: Configured budget in USD; present only when a budget is set

budget_used_pct.description: Percentage of budget consumed; present only when a budget is set

unmeasured_calls.description: Agent calls across all tasks whose cost the CLI never reported. Added 2.29.0. When > 0, `total_cost` is a floor, not a total. Absent in output from <2.29.0.

pr_review_cost.description: Total USD spent by `review-pr` in this state file. Separate from `total_cost`, which remains the TASK total and is unaffected by this key. Added 2.31.0; present only when the PR ledger has rows.

pr_review_unmeasured_calls.description: Review-pr calls whose cost the CLI never reported. When > 0, `pr_review_cost` is a floor. Added 2.31.0.

repo_total_cost.description: `total_cost` + `pr_review_cost` — the two ledgers summed at the point of asking, never merged at the point of writing. Added 2.31.0; present only when the PR ledger has rows.

pr_ledger_since.description: First version that recorded review-pr calls. Sessions from earlier versions are missing from the ledger — incomplete history, not free work. Added 2.31.0.
